name: Bluesky
description: Your Bluesky in any prifly session: read your timeline, notifications, threads, profiles and search, and post, reply and send messages after you confirm each one.

settings.label: Your Bluesky handle
settings.description: Optional override, for example you.bsky.social (no @). Left empty, the handle is read from the Vault: an API token named "bluesky-handle" holding it, or "<handle> <app password>" in the "bluesky" token. The app password goes in Settings -> Vault as an API token named "bluesky"; make one at https://bsky.app/settings/app-passwords.
